title: LinkedIn: Job Matching, Recommendations, and Skill Endorsements
description: Add job recommendation engine, skill endorsements, and profile views.

data.text: Extend LinkedIn with job recommendations based on skills, skill endorsements from connections, and profile view tracking.

data.title: JobMatcher and EndorsementService
Why skill endorsements matter
data.text: Endorsements add social proof to skills. A skill with 50 endorsements ranks higher than the same skill with 2 endorsements in search results.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: JobMatcher ranks by skill overlap count
Skill endorsements boost job match ranking
data.takeaway: LinkedIn value comes from the professional graph. Jobs match by skills. Endorsements add credibility. The graph gets stronger with every connection.
